name: Ashok Ram
tagline: I build new features, take on open tasks and fix bugs in open-source developer tools and AI infrastructure, every change shipped with tests.

contributions.what: tauri dev stopped watching the whole app when .taurignore contained /*. Fixed to match .gitignore semantics, with a unit test and an end-to-end check
Crash-safety: a panic in a command's pre-checks or bookkeeping crashed the app; now caught and reported as an error, with a regression test
Root-caused "Offset Path resets 0.1 mm to 1 mm": decimal-comma input is rejected and the field silently keeps its old value. Proposed three fixes for the maintainers to choose from

noUselessEmptyExport deleted a meaningful export {} from .d.ts files, leaking private types into the public API. The rule now skips declaration files, matching typescript-eslint; fixtures and changeset included
Out-of-bounds read in n-gram speculative drafting when the input is shorter than the n-gram size. Bounds check plus a sanitizer-verified regression test
A small EMF/WMF file could hold many maximum-size embedded images and tie up the app for minutes. Each file now gets one decoded-pixel budget, charged before decoding, with a regression test
SVG import now reads rounded rectangle corners (rx/ry) as the SVG spec defines them. Circular corners become true CAD arcs and elliptical ones are traced, from CADCraft's own gap list

PRAGMA data_version, the cheap SQLite way to poll for changes. It moves when another connection or process commits and never for the connection's own commits, matching SQLite case by case, with a cross-process test
